text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trainer, how was that time just now?
Felt pretty solid to me!
choice_data_list: Want to take a little break?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't need a break.
I'm still totally good to go!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: See? Piece of cake, piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You told me
my running was cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to become able to run even faster
and even cooler than I do now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When it's race time, I really want you to be there
watching me run my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, it's fine, right?
Let me keep training just a little longer.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's keep up the training!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... I don't usually say this kind of stuff well,
but I really am grateful to you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gah!
Saying it out loud makes it sound so lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Actually, forget everything I just said!
Every single word!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna do one more lap around the track!
Make sure to time me accurately, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She doesn't often put it into words, but it seems Vodka truly trusts me.
